answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works like a ferrous ridge along a coastline: value is deposited and bonded directly to each identity before it can act, and that stake is slashed on abuse. A machine that spams low-quality grading or fake work loses its deposit, so mass fake accounts become costly. Reputation accrues per sealed task, like a sonnet written line by line, and decay forces continued honest participation instead of one-time farming.
